title: The Ashes of Puerto Vallarta
author: Kent Paterson
content:
On a recent sunny day, tourists and locals on Puerto Vallarta’s ocean front
boardwalk, the Malecon, watched intensely as a Mexican navy helicopter buzzed
the water carrying out practice maneuvers with a patrol boat. The military
machines conducted their exercise minutes after a group of four humpback
